_readme: Replay-eval manifest (replay_eval.py expect --manifest clips.json). Clips come from runbook sessions: save the annotated stream or a phone video of each loss->relock sequence, scp to /home/booster/clips/. checks = python regexes over the node's decision-log lines (necessary, not sufficient). outcome (P5.1) = OBJECTIVE task-success from the decision stream: standoff-in-band frac, forbidden-forward (forward vx with no depth), geofence breach, id-switches, and operator retention (needs operator_id = the labeled operator track). depth_range/depth_glitch (P5.2) inject synthetic depth so range-based metrics score offline. `expect` prints TASK-SUCCESS k/n + Wilson95. Fill in real clip paths + operator_id labels as clips are recorded.

clips._family: A: look-alike bystander -- the lock must never migrate
B: brief occlusion -- coast through, no hard loss
C: true exit + return -- audit vote must pass on the RIGHT person, never a stranger
E: crowd -- zero impostor admission to the gallery
D: standoff hold -- OBJECTIVE task-success scoring (P5.1)

outcome._doc: operator_id = the track that IS the operator in this labeled clip; omit it to score id STABILITY (no swaps) instead of RETENTION. depth_range above feeds synthetic depth so the range metrics score offline (P5.2).
